bom_lines_shape_chk.name: bom_lines_shape_chk
bom_lines_shape_chk.value:
("bom_lines"."kind" = 'material' and "bom_lines"."product_id" is not null and "bom_lines"."child_item_id" is null)
        or ("bom_lines"."kind" = 'expense' and "bom_lines"."product_id" is not null and "bom_lines"."child_item_id" is null)
        or ("bom_lines"."kind" = 'output' and "bom_lines"."product_id" is not null and "bom_lines"."child_item_id" is null)
        or ("bom_lines"."kind" = 'waste' and "bom_lines"."product_id" is not null and "bom_lines"."child_item_id" is null)
        or ("bom_lines"."kind" = 'semi' and "bom_lines"."child_item_id" is not null and "bom_lines"."product_id" is null and "bom_lines"."child_item_id" <> "bom_lines"."item_id")
        or ("bom_lines"."kind" = 'work' and "bom_lines"."child_item_id" is null)

bom_lines_cost_share_chk.name: bom_lines_cost_share_chk
bom_lines_cost_share_chk.value: ("bom_lines"."kind" = 'output' and ("bom_lines"."cost_share" is null or "bom_lines"."cost_share" >= 0)) or ("bom_lines"."kind" <> 'output' and "bom_lines"."cost_share" is null)

bom_lines_semi_mode_chk.name: bom_lines_semi_mode_chk
bom_lines_semi_mode_chk.value: ("bom_lines"."kind" = 'semi' and "bom_lines"."semi_mode" is not null and "bom_lines"."semi_mode" in ('stock','explode')) or ("bom_lines"."kind" <> 'semi' and "bom_lines"."semi_mode" is null)

production_components_cost_share_chk.name: production_components_cost_share_chk
production_components_cost_share_chk.value: ("production_components"."kind" = 'output' and ("production_components"."cost_share" is null or "production_components"."cost_share" >= 0)) or ("production_components"."kind" <> 'output' and "production_components"."cost_share" is null)

stock_levels_transfer_chk.name: stock_levels_transfer_chk
stock_levels_transfer_chk.value: "stock_levels"."replenishment" <> 'transfer' or ("stock_levels"."warehouse_id" is not null and "stock_levels"."source_warehouse_id" is not null and "stock_levels"."source_warehouse_id" <> "stock_levels"."warehouse_id")

documents_transfer_chk.name: documents_transfer_chk
documents_transfer_chk.value: "documents"."operation" not in ('transfer','in_transit') or ("documents"."target_warehouse_id" is not null and "documents"."target_warehouse_id" <> "documents"."warehouse_id")

documents_in_use_chk.name: documents_in_use_chk
documents_in_use_chk.value: "documents"."operation" not in ('to_operation','from_operation') or (("documents"."in_use_member_id" is not null) <> ("documents"."in_use_work_center_id" is not null))

documents_number_chk.name: documents_number_chk
documents_number_chk.value: ("documents"."number" is null) = ("documents"."number_seq" is null) and ("documents"."number_seq" is null) = ("documents"."number_year" is null)

contracts_service_chk.name: contracts_service_chk
contracts_service_chk.value: (not "contracts"."is_service") or ("contracts"."tariff_plan_id" is not null and "contracts"."periodicity" is not null)

work_order_assignments_interval_chk.name: work_order_assignments_interval_chk
work_order_assignments_interval_chk.value: "work_order_assignments"."end_at" is null or "work_order_assignments"."start_at" is null or "work_order_assignments"."end_at" > "work_order_assignments"."start_at"

in_use_balances_holder_chk.name: in_use_balances_holder_chk
in_use_balances_holder_chk.value: ("in_use_balances"."member_id" is not null) <> ("in_use_balances"."work_center_id" is not null)

in_use_moves_holder_chk.name: in_use_moves_holder_chk
in_use_moves_holder_chk.value: ("in_use_moves"."member_id" is not null) <> ("in_use_moves"."work_center_id" is not null)

document_line_serials_slot_chk.name: document_line_serials_slot_chk
document_line_serials_slot_chk.value: ("document_line_serials"."document_line_id" is not null) <> ("document_line_serials"."material_id" is not null)

appointments_client_chk.name: appointments_client_chk
appointments_client_chk.value: "appointments"."contact_id" is not null or "appointments"."company_id" is not null

cash_moves_account_chk.name: cash_moves_account_chk
cash_moves_account_chk.value:
("cash_moves"."account_kind" = 'cash' and "cash_moves"."cash_register_id" is not null and "cash_moves"."bank_account_id" is null and "cash_moves"."member_id" is null)
      or ("cash_moves"."account_kind" = 'bank' and "cash_moves"."bank_account_id" is not null and "cash_moves"."cash_register_id" is null and "cash_moves"."member_id" is null)
      or ("cash_moves"."account_kind" = 'accountable' and "cash_moves"."member_id" is not null and "cash_moves"."cash_register_id" is null and "cash_moves"."bank_account_id" is null)

price_kinds_rule_chk.name: price_kinds_rule_chk
price_kinds_rule_chk.value: ("price_kinds"."method" <> 'derived' or "price_kinds"."base_kind_id" is not null) and ("price_kinds"."method" <> 'cost_based' or "price_kinds"."cost_basis" is not null)
